name: Ni Yu Zuori zhi Hai
source:
Xiamen, Fujian Province, 2024. One day, 19-year-old Xiamen University student Gu Mengzhi meets a sea spirit named Coral, and the two quickly become close. However, as their bond deepens, a stranger appears and disrupts everything. The stranger seems to want to kidnap Mengzhi for some reason. Soon, Mengzhi realizes she's been caught up in a conspiracy. What's really going on? Will Mengzhi and Coral be able to uncover the truth and get away safely?

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4849190/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
2024年，福建厦门。某一天，19岁的厦门大学学生顾梦栀邂逅了一位名叫珊瑚的海精灵，两人很快熟络起来。然而随着感情日益深厚，一名陌生人突然出现并打破了原本的一切。这名陌生人似乎出于某种原因企图绑架梦栀。很快，梦栀意识到自己已被卷入一场阴谋之中。这一切背后究竟隐藏着什么？梦栀和珊瑚能否揭开真相、平安脱险？

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4849190/]Steam[/url]]
